newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 15.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
** Around 32 hotel project worth 7.74 trillion rupiah in Jakarta have been delayed due to financing problems and difficulties in obtaining permits from government agencies.

** The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 40.62 points to close at a record 6,010.00 on Monday as investors celebrated moderate U.S. economic growth coupled with low inflation -- an ideal recipe for corporate earnings.

** The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.25 points, or 0.04 percent, to close at 570.98 points on Monday on profit-taking in selected blue-chips, including car-maker Astra and some secondaries, despite gains in market heavyweight Telkom.
** On Tuesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,320.85/21.25 in early trading against an opening of 2,320.50/21.50.

** Astra on reports that several business tycoons and pension funds linked with large banks were reported to be interested in selling their stakes in Astra to the Nusamba Group, consisting of foundations controlled by President Suharto.
** Sampoerna on market talk that the tobacco giant founder and president director Putra Sampoerna was likely to sell his holding in Astra to the Nusamba Group.
** Davomas following an announcement that the cocoa butter manufacturer's first nine months net profit almost doubled against the previous period last year.
** Budi Acid Jaya on an announcement it planned to acquire assets of related firm PT Budi Acid Makmur and to buy a stake in PT Budi Rasio International.
